title: Madhya Pradesh Bar Association Launches Mentorship Programme For Young Women Lawyers And Interns
description: The Madhya Pradesh Bar Association of Indore has kick-started a 'first-of-a-kind' mentorship programme for young women members and interns of the bar.� The programme aims to provide guidance, career insights, and professional support to young women in the profession.� The pilot project commenced on Friday (July 17) with over 80 participants under the guidance of Treasurer Kirti Patwardhan and Executive Members Sonali Shukla and Agreema Sanghai.
